descriptions.notStarted: What do I have to do to choose a job of my liking? I'll have to see Olaf of Lith Harbor.
descriptions.inProgress: I'll have to listen to #p1002101# carely as he describes the in's and out's of each and every job, because he'll quiz me on it afterwards.
descriptions.completed: I answered all the questions #p1002101# asked. I'll have to be at least on #blevel 10#k in order to become a #ba Warrior, a Thief, a Bowman, or a Pirate#k, and #blevel 8#k to become a #bMagician#k. Warrior-hopefuls will need to head over to Perion for job-advancement, Kerning City for thief-hopefuls, Ellinia for magician-hopefuls, and Henesys for Bowman-hopefuls.
